title: vouch — .safe-dep.json
description: Configuration for vouch. All keys are optional; defaults apply when omitted. Editors that respect $schema (VS Code, WebStorm, lspconfig) will offer autocomplete + validation while you type.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema. Enables editor autocomplete + validation.

packageManager.description: Which package manager vouch invokes when adding deps. 'auto' reads the Corepack packageManager field, then sniffs lockfiles, then falls back to npm.

allowScopedPackages.description: Glob-like patterns (only '*' is special). Matched packages bypass the install-time risk gate — e.g. ['@your-org/*'] for trusted internal packages.

minimumVersionAgeHours.description: A new version younger than this many hours is blocked at install time.

warnVersionAgeHours.description: A version younger than this many hours (but past the minimum) is warned about at install time. Default = 7 days.

blockInstallScripts.description: Block packages that ship preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare scripts. Override with --force-with-reason.

requireCooldownConfigured.description: Warn when the project's package manager has no release-age cooldown configured (e.g. pnpm minimumReleaseAge, npm min-release-age).

versionDrift.description: Deprecated and ignored. `vouch check` is now always version-aware: it resolves each dependency's installed version from node_modules and asserts that exact name@version was reviewed. The versionDrift setting has no effect and will be removed in a future release.

requirePinned.description: Opt-in pinning policy. 'warn' on recorded deps that use a range (^, ~, ...) instead of an exact version. Default off to avoid flooding typical ^-range projects.

checkPeerDependencies.description: Also gate peerDependencies in `vouch check`. Off by default: peers are usually host-provided contracts. dependencies, devDependencies, and optionalDependencies are always gated.

cveAtInstall.description: What `vouch <pkg>` does on a known advisory at install time. 'warn' surfaces a note; 'block' refuses to install when severity ≥ cveAtInstallMinSeverity; 'off' skips the check entirely. Fail-open: an unreachable advisory service is silent.

cveAtInstallMinSeverity.description: Minimum advisory severity that blocks when cveAtInstall is 'block'. Lower severities still warn.
